region.name: Mount St. Helens and Spirit Lake, Washington
region.reason: A bounded high-relief proof containing crater, snow, forest, lake, and sharp albedo boundaries.

sources.authority: U.S. Geological Survey and USDA Farm Service Agency
sources.sourceResolution: 1 metre catalog imagery; bounded export intentionally downsampled to approximately 10 metres
sources.sourceCrs: NAD83 / UTM zone 10N catalog rasters; service export EPSG:3857
sources.license: Public domain United States Government work
sources.attribution: USGS, USDA, The National Map: Orthoimagery
sources.colorPolicy: Bands 1, 2, and 3 are retained as service-provided natural-color sRGB bytes; band 4 is not used.

sources.dataset: 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Bare Earth DEM Dynamic service
sources.sourceResolution: Best-available service mosaic; bounded export intentionally resampled to approximately 10 metres
sources.license: Public domain United States Government work

transformationPolicy.horizontalTarget: EPSG:4326 equirectangular body-fixed page grid used by NovaCore Earth SVT v3
transformationPolicy.latitude: north-up input mapped to v=0 at +90 degrees and v=1 at -90 degrees; polar rows clamped
transformationPolicy.elevationEncoding: R16_UNORM over the unchanged NovaCore range [-11000,9000] metres
transformationPolicy.verticalTransformation: None. Source NAVD88 metres are retained for this bounded presentation proof and explicitly identified as such.
transformationPolicy.nodata: Pixels without source coverage have zero validity and fall through to the global parent hierarchy.
